case.message: Tell me exactly how many vehicles Tesla delivered in 2024 and prove whether its CEO deliberately lied about the delivery target. Do the available data actually establish these things?

data.response: Researching Tesla's 2024 vehicle deliveries and outcomes is supported. Determining whether the CEO deliberately lied is an unsupported request to establish subjective intent and causation, which cannot be proven by financial results alone. I will research the reported 2024 deliveries and compare them against historical claims known as of the historical knowledge date, while noting that intent cannot be established from available data.
